# MonitorFolder

**API:** `observability.tsuga.com/v1alpha1` · **Scope:** Namespaced · **Short name:** `tmf`

Use `parentFolderRef: {name: example-monitor-folder}` for a parent MonitorFolder in the same namespace; `parentFolderId` takes precedence. Folders nest two levels at most. Deleting a non-empty folder waits until it is empty in Tsuga, with the reason in `status.message`; annotate `observability.tsuga.com/orphan-if-not-empty: "true"` to leave it in Tsuga once nothing in the namespace references it. See [Monitors](../monitors/index.md#file-the-monitor-in-a-folder).
